title: llm-kit paid call record, version 1
description: The two records a call ledger sink (@katsoft/llm-kit-send setCallLedger, 0.4.0 and later) gets for each call that can be billed: `begin`, written before the first byte of the request leaves, and `end`, written when the call ends, with the same `id`. Never prompt or reply text, never a query string, never a key. Every field is present (null when unknown). A sink that stores the records keeps this shape and may add its own fields beside it in its own store. Written in llm-scripting-kit.json-schema-subset/v1. Contract and shared cases: docs/reference/llm-kit-formats.md.

id.description: The call id: one per record pair; the same string in the end record.

transport.description: The package function that sent the call: postChat, sendChat, sendWithRetries, postImages, postVenice, ideogramEdit, postFal, elevenLabsRequest, falQueue or sunraQueue.

method.description: The HTTP method of the (first) request, upper case.

host.description: The URL host (with a port when the URL names one). Empty when the URL cannot be parsed.

path.description: The URL path with no query, no fragment and no user information; never a key.

model.description: The model or endpoint the request names, or an empty string when it names none.

stream.description: True when the request asks for a server-sent event stream.

attempt.description: The try number, from 1: a retry of sendWithRetries, or the reasoning-off retry of sendChat, is a new record.

startedAt.description: When the call began, in milliseconds since the epoch.

labels.description: The caller's labels for the call (the `labels` option); the package never reads them.

id.description: The call id of the begin record.

endedAt.description: When the call ended, in milliseconds since the epoch.

ok.description: True when the call gave a complete answer: a 2xx answer whose body was read (a queue job: its result).

status.description: The HTTP status of the last answer, or null with no response.

errorKind.description: What failed, or null: a SendError kind (http, network, body, no_first_token, stalled, slow, stream_error, incomplete, aborted), `error` for an unexpected exception, `cancelled` for a body the reader cancelled, or `<stage>:<code>` for a queue job.

aborted.description: True when the caller's signal, a deadline or a stream limit cut the call after it was sent.

replayed.description: True when the reply cache answered and nothing was sent.

servedModel.description: The model the provider reported, or null.

provider.description: The host that served the call, when the provider named it, or null.

generationId.description: The provider's id of the generation (the `id` of the answer or of the stream chunks), or null.

usage.description: The usage object the provider reported, as sent, or null.

cost.description: The cost the host reported, in US dollars, or null. 0 for a replay.
